preconditions.description: Input is a single integer n between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.strip().split()[i]) == math.gcd(*range(1, n+1)) if i == 0 else int(stdout.strip().split()[i]) == math.gcd(*[x for x in range(1, n+1) if x not in removed]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th output integer is the GCD of the remaining elements after removing i elements in some order, where the order is chosen to maximize lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == sorted([str(math.gcd(*[x for x in range(1, n+1) if x not in removed])) for removed in permutations(range(1, n+1))], reverse=True)[0].split()
postconditions.description: The output sequence is the lexicographically maximum possible result of the transformation.
